The following events took place in '''129 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The practice of the popular and highly dangerous sport of [[pit racing]] is begun in the [[garbage pit]]s of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. {{C|Possible date}}<ref name="Rogue Planet pit racing" />
*[[Charza Kwinn]] begins to work as a pilot for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. {{C|Latest possible date}}<ref name="Rogue Planet Kwinn">In ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', set in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Thracia Cho Leem]] mentions that Kwinn has served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for "over a century".</ref>
*[[Tsinimal]]s overrun the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langhesa]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the native [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Langhesi]], forcing huge migrations to other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
